senses.zh_definition: 盖乌斯：拉丁来源的男性人名，见于古罗马及基督教文献；具体所指须由上下文确定。
senses.en_definition: Gaius, a masculine personal name of Latin origin, used by various Roman and biblical figures.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas lelaki daripada tradisi Latin, digunakan oleh beberapa tokoh Rom dan tokoh dalam teks Kristian.
senses.nuances: 此项是专名识别说明，不是已核实的 DBP 普通词释义；因此不能标作 official。输入小写形式无法确定具体人物。下列项目为有文献依据的人名组合，并非马来语高频搭配。名字及其不确定词源参见 [Dictionary of Medieval Names from European Sources：Gaius](https://dmnes.org/2016/3/name/Gaius)。

etymology.historical_story: Gaius was a common Roman personal name, borne by Julius Caesar and several people mentioned in Christian texts. Medieval name scholarship also records the spelling Caius. Its ultimate origin is uncertain: a connection with Latin gaudere, meaning to rejoice, has been proposed, but should not be presented as settled fact. In Malay text, it should first be recognized as a name.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 Gaius，先联想到 Gaius Julius Caesar：这是人名，按整词记忆，不作马来语词缀拆分。
